zh-TW.title: 1.7.0 有什麼新功能
highlights: 可以調整課表與主畫面小工具中的課名字型大小。
App Store 上推出新版本時，會在 App 內提醒你更新。
升級後首次開啟會顯示這個「新功能」說明。

en.title: What's new in 1.7.0
highlights: Resize course names in the class table and home-screen widgets.
We'll let you know when a new release is ready on the App Store.
After upgrading, this 'What's new' summary appears on first launch.

en.title: What's new in 1.8.0
highlights: Bulletin push notifications, with a switch in Settings to turn them off.
The app offers to update itself, and shows what changed once you install.
Flip your phone face-down to bring up your library QR code.
Passwords and the library QR are now hidden from screenshots and screen recordings.

zh-TW.title: 1.8.0 更新內容
highlights: 公告推播通知，可在設定中隨時關閉。
有新版本時會主動提醒，更新後告訴你這一版改了什麼。
手機翻面朝下即可叫出圖書證 QR Code。
密碼與圖書證 QR 在截圖和螢幕錄影中會自動遮蔽。

zh-TW.title: 2.0.0 更新內容
highlights: 雲端同步正式上線：課表、作業、課程顏色與自訂課名會在 iPhone 與 Mac 之間即時同步。
重設課表可只重設目前學期；仍缺教室的課程會在重新整理時補查。
歷年成績頁載入更快，尚未有排名的學期會先顯示預估 GPA。
首頁勾選完成作業後課表標記立即更新；時光機在衝堂時也能正常拖曳。
Apple Watch 的圖書證 QR Code 改由 iPhone 取得，不再容易過期。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.0
highlights: Cloud sync is live: your class table, assignments, course colours and custom names stay in step across iPhone and Mac.
Reset the class table for just the current semester, and courses still missing a room get looked up again on refresh.
The grades page loads faster, and terms without a ranking yet show an estimated GPA.
Ticking off an assignment on Home updates the class table badge right away, and the time slider drags fine on clashing courses.
The Apple Watch library QR code now comes through your iPhone, so it stays fresh.

zh-TW.title: 2.0.1 更新內容
highlights: 課表的學期選單只會列出入學年以後的學期。
設定中的主題色現在也套用到圖示、圖書證倒數圈與歷年成績趨勢線。
選課系統目前開放的學期以選課清單為準，已退選的課不會再從 Moodle 被加回課表。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.1
highlights: The class table's semester menu only lists terms from your admission year onward.
Your theme colour now reaches icons, the library QR countdown ring and the GPA trend line.
The term the course-selection system is serving follows its enrolment list, so dropped courses no longer come back from Moodle.

zh-TW.title: 2.0.2 更新內容
highlights: 新增校方行事曆：學期起訖、假日與補課日一次看完，Mac 版也有。
課程的動態島改由伺服器啟動，App 沒開著也會準時出現。
在另一台裝置重置學期後，這台裝置會跟著清空並自動重新抓取。
課表看得到每一節的上下課時間，也可以固定顯示第 10 節與 A、B、C 節。
設定裡可以自訂並驗證 API 端點，並新增「檢查伺服器狀態」。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.2
highlights: A new Academic Calendar shows term dates, holidays and make-up days — on Mac too.
Live Activities for classes now start from the server, so a class shows up on time even when the app isn't open.
Reset a semester on one device and this one empties and refetches to match.
The class table shows each period's start and end time, and can always display periods 10, A, B and C.
Settings lets you set and validate a custom API endpoint, and adds a "Check Server Status" row.

zh-TW.title: 2.1.0 更新內容
highlights: 作業提醒改由伺服器送出，App 沒開著也會準時提醒。
已經在 Moodle 繳交的作業，不會再提醒你交。
通知設定會跨裝置同步，在一台調整好，其他裝置就跟著更新。
Moodle 登入過期時，通知會說清楚發生什麼事，不再是一則空白橫幅。
預先排好的課程動態島不會再被 App 自己關掉。

en.title: What's new in 2.1.0
highlights: Assignment reminders now come from the server, so they arrive on time even when the app isn't open.
Assignments you have already submitted on Moodle stop reminding you.
Notification settings sync across your devices — change them on one and the rest follow.
When your Moodle login expires, the notification explains what happened instead of arriving blank.
Scheduled class Live Activities are no longer ended by the app itself.
